description:
This file contains the PHP implementation of the SubscriptionStatus class within the Opencart
documentation namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve subscription status information,
including a specific status by ID and all statuses available, with caching support.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching and caching subscription status data from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription status by its ID, considering the current language setting.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Fetches all subscription statuses available for the current language, utilizing caching to optimize repeated requests.
